description: PR auto-approval policy. A PR is auto-approved only when every condition below holds; anything else goes to a human reviewer.

rules: Any changed file matching humanReview.paths, even if it also matches allowedPaths (agent instructions, CI, schema, dependencies, env files and this policy itself).
A diff above maxDiff.lines (additions + deletions) or maxDiff.files, or containing a binary file (its size cannot be measured).
A PR with no added or modified file left to check (deletion-only).
Any required check that is missing, failed, ran a command other than the policy's, or ran on another commit or a dirty tree.
Evidence that is missing, malformed, or for a commit other than the PR head.
A file list in the evidence that does not match the diff the controller recomputes from git.
A diff base other than the merge-base of the PR head with <remote>/<baseBranch>.
A PR head that cannot be read with git ls-remote, or that changes before the decision is recorded.
